en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural settlement with scattered wooden houses, barns, cultivated fields divided by fences, and rocky foreground terrain. In the distance there is a lake or large body of water and low hills on the horizon. The word "Orivesi." is printed in red in the upper left corner, and handwritten text "v. 1908." appears in the upper right corner.
